footnotes.text: "Balances reflect a) 9,204 shares transferred from a Grantor Retained Annuity Trust (""GRAT"") to the Grantor on May 8, 2026; b) 7,517 shares transferred from a GRAT to the Grantor on May 8, 2026; c) 2,592 shares transferred from a GRAT to a Family Trust on May 11, 2026; d) 17,553 shares transferred from a GRAT to the Grantor on May 14, 2026; and e) 54,385 shares transferred from the Grantor to fund a GRAT on May 15, 2026. These transactions are exempt from Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16a-13."
